raw.question: list all customers and vendors

naive.question: list all customers and vendors
naive.sql:
SELECT
  res_partner.id,
  res_partner.name,
  res_partner.email,
  res_partner.phone,
  res_partner.mobile,
  res_partner.customer_rank,
  res_partner.supplier_rank,
  CASE
    WHEN res_partner.customer_rank > 0 AND res_partner.supplier_rank > 0 THEN 'customer_and_vendor'
    WHEN res_partner.customer_rank > 0 THEN 'customer'
    WHEN res_partner.supplier_rank > 0 THEN 'vendor'
  END AS partner_type
FROM res_partner
WHERE res_partner.customer_rank > 0
   OR res_partner.supplier_rank > 0
ORDER BY res_partner.name, res_partner.id

raw.question: top 5 customers by total sales order value

naive.question: top 5 customers by total sales order value
naive.sql:
SELECT
  rp.id AS customer_id,
  rp.name AS customer_name,
  SUM(so.amount_total) AS total_sales_order_value
FROM sale_order AS so
JOIN res_partner AS rp
  ON rp.id = so.partner_id
GROUP BY
  rp.id,
  rp.name
ORDER BY
  total_sales_order_value DESC,
  rp.id
LIMIT 5

raw.question: number of project tasks per project, descending

naive.question: number of project tasks per project, descending
naive.sql:
SELECT
  pp.id AS project_id,
  pp.name AS project_name,
  COUNT(pt.id) AS task_count
FROM project_project AS pp
LEFT JOIN project_task AS pt
  ON pt.project_id = pp.id
GROUP BY
  pp.id,
  pp.name
ORDER BY
  task_count DESC,
  pp.id
